_comment: Ground-truth state-classification corpus for TMUX-69. Every `tail` is REAL pane text captured from driving that CLI through tmux-agent (or, where noted, the real strings the profile was written from), normalised to the LAST 6 NON-EMPTY lines — the exact window Monitor.snapshot() classifies (monitor.ts: tail = lines.slice(-6)). `expected` is the state a human observer assigns from the pane alone. `note` records why. This corpus GROWS per misclassification found in the wild (regression per incident); test/state-accuracy.test.js grades against it and fails if BLOCKED or ERROR recall drops below 100% or overall accuracy regresses below the recorded floor. A missed BLOCKED/ERROR is the worst output this tool can produce — a session waiting on a human, or stuck erroring, that reads calm.
